meta.phase-name: game.ts Extraction Map and First Module Split

phase-plan.purpose: Define the extraction map for `packages/engine/src/escape-the-dungeon/engine/game.ts` and perform the first bounded module split without changing runtime behavior.
phase-plan.scope: In scope: helper/bootstrap/serialization extraction map and first non-behavioral module moves. Out of scope: full action-family decomposition and gameplay rewrites.

file.description: Current monolithic runtime orchestrator and rules file to be decomposed.
Architecture doc should map the target module structure and phase order.

task.description: Inventory `game.ts` into bootstrap, helper, action-family, event, progression, history, and serialization sections with exact extraction targets.
Extract pure helpers and serialization/status functions into separate modules with parity-preserving imports.

decision.summary: `game.ts` decomposition must proceed by small extraction slices, not a one-shot rewrite.
decision.impact: Keeps the engine stable while module boundaries are introduced.
